purpose: Train the first reproducible two-agent MAPPO base-policy pilot on the frozen Town02 scenario pool.

parameter_rationale.ppo_epochs: Five epochs is the conservative end of the 5-10 epoch range reported for difficult cooperative MAPPO tasks and limits policy non-stationarity.
parameter_rationale.minibatch_size: 32768 covers the worst-case two-agent critic batch from 16 episodes x 1000 steps, so each PPO epoch uses one full batch rather than repeatedly fragmenting the same rollout.
parameter_rationale.clip_and_kl: clip_eps=0.15 is stricter than the common 0.2 setting without entering the very small clipping regime; target_kl=0.02 remains an independent early-stop guard.
parameter_rationale.discount_and_gae: gamma=0.997 preserves the existing long-horizon design for an approximately 1000-step driving task; lambda=0.95 retains the standard GAE bias-variance compromise.
parameter_rationale.learning_rates: 3e-4 actor and critic learning rates, gradient norm 0.5, and decay over the full 100-update plan were finite and bounded in the P0 smoke run and remain unchanged for causal traceability.
parameter_rationale.exploration: entropy coefficient 0.03 and init_log_std=0.0 are retained for the first pilot segment; action-boundary rate, entropy, KL, and clip fraction are preregistered monitoring signals instead of being tuned after observing success outcomes.
parameter_rationale.seed_policy: Seed 42 is the single engineering pilot seed. Multi-seed confirmation is a later contract and must not be inferred from this pilot.
